name: Sports Toto Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司没有公告涉及任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，也没有获得新合约。主要公告为与关联方的交易，包括认购 Berjaya Yokohama、BGRB Venture 及 Berjaya IPS Equity 发行的伊斯兰债券/中期票据，以及出售 7-Eleven Malaysia Holdings Berhad 和 Berjaya Assets Berhad 的股份。此外，公司宣布了多次中期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company made no announcements regarding expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of any business segment, nor did it secure any new contracts. The main announcements were related party transactions, including subscriptions to Islamic medium-term notes issued by Berjaya Yokohama, BGRB Venture, and Berjaya IPS Equity, as well as disposals of shares in 7-Eleven Malaysia Holdings Berhad and Berjaya Assets Berhad. The company also declared several interim dividends.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年集团层面的公告主要涉及关联方票据认购、股份出售及股息宣派，未涉及具体业务板块的运营变化。
segments.note_en: Group-level announcements this year mainly involved related party note subscriptions, share disposals, and dividend declarations, with no operational changes to specific business segments.
